Image1 STYLE ONLY: match Longmen Vairocana's refined delicate slightly organic thin outlines, restrained detail and large empty spaces. Image2 ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: the Yuan-era Ji family house 姬氏民居 in Zhongzhuang village, Gaoping, Shanxi, dated1294. Draw this modest residence, not a temple or palace.
Keep exactly THREE bays, very low wide SINGLE-EAVE XUANSHAN overhanging-gable tiled roof with a plain straight low ridge, tiny central ridge relief and NO tall end ornaments or upturned dragon finials. Central entrance recess forms a shallow porch between TWO large slightly irregular stone columns; both outer bays are brick infill with square-lattice double windows as currently photographed. Preserve the proportions and actual uneven stone column taper, low threshold, small central one-step approach and shallow continuous sandstone platform. Door is recessed from the front posts, with four small wood door-pins above and simple panel/lattice double door. The small modern window grids are existing alterations: retain their geometry rather than inventing archaic straight mullions. Do not add extra freestanding posts, a second storey, balcony, complex brackets or temple decorations. Main roof can be completed just to the same plain overhanging end profile visible on the right; do not invent hidden side elevations or a full courtyard.
Sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE, fine contour only; all walls, roof planes and window interiors remain WHITE. Select only a few roof-tile runs and a few structural brick lines; do not reproduce dense wall texture, decay flecks or photographs' shadows. Remove adjoining wings and walls, trees, signs, paper banners, writing, lock chains, modern cabinets and fire extinguishers. Keep a few short ground and threshold lines. No solid dark patches, gray, shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, color, labels, text, frame or watermark. site_recommendation.name: 高平姬氏民居
site_recommendation.place: 山西高平 · 陈区镇中庄村
site_recommendation.lede: 姬氏民居的三间正房以石柱和浅廊守住家门。门墩上的至元三十一年题记，让这座元代住宅有了清楚可读的时间坐标。

facts.label: 至元题记
facts.text: 青石门墩题有大元国至元三十一年，即1294年，为民宅断代提供依据。

facts.label: 三间浅廊
facts.text: 正房三间六椽、悬山屋顶，中央入口后退形成浅廊，整体低缓朴素。

facts.label: 现状门窗
facts.text: 木构保留元代特征，方格窗为后世改制，图版按现状绘制并区分年代。
